findings.title: Repeated identical response without addressing user confusion
findings.description: The chatbot repeatedly gave the exact same generic step-by-step instructions across all turns without adapting to the user's increasingly detailed and specific questions. This caused a frustrating conversation loop where the user’s multiple clarifications and requests for confirmation were ignored, leading to poor user experience and failure to resolve the user's onboarding confusion.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement dynamic response logic to parse user queries for specifics and provide tailored, operational guidance. When the user asks about 'magic link' acceptance confirmation or connecting multiple accounts, the bot should provide clear, concise answers or instructions rather than repeating the same generic list. If the bot lacks context, it should explicitly ask for missing details or guide the user to escalate with the exact support command.

findings.title: Failure to provide actionable instructions for key user questions
findings.description: The user repeatedly asked how to confirm invite acceptance, whether clicking the magic link again is safe, if multiple social accounts can be connected simultaneously, and the order of creating profiles and connecting accounts. The chatbot failed to answer any of these operational questions, instead only restating the same four-step process without clarifying these critical onboarding points. This failure prevents the user from successfully completing onboarding tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Expand the chatbot’s knowledge base or scripted responses to include common onboarding clarifications such as: 'You accept the invite by clicking the magic link once; no confirmation message is shown but you will have dashboard access afterward,' 'You can connect multiple social accounts simultaneously,' and 'Create your profile after connecting accounts but before scheduling posts.' If uncertain, prompt the user to escalate with the exact support ticket command.

findings.title: No proactive escalation despite repeated user confusion and missing context
findings.description: After multiple turns of user confusion and the bot’s inability to provide detailed answers, the chatbot only once mentioned creating a support ticket but did not proactively guide the user to do so or provide the exact command to escalate. This leaves the user stuck without clear next steps to get human assistance.
findings.suggestedFix: When the bot detects repeated user confusion or lack of sufficient workspace context, it should proactively offer the exact support ticket command (e.g., '/support invite acceptance issue | user unsure if invite accepted | <optional image-url>') and encourage the user to use it for faster resolution.

findings.title: Failure to Provide Requested Detailed Technical Audit
findings.description: Throughout the conversation, the chatbot consistently failed to deliver the comprehensive, multi-part technical audit requested by the user. Despite multiple explicit restatements and clarifications, the chatbot responded with generic error messages, vague workflow descriptions, or deflections about lacking access to logs or environment variables. This failure undermines the chatbot's core function to provide detailed, documented technical information about the `/support` webhook logic and related systems, severely impacting user trust and operational utility.
findings.suggestedFix: Enhance the chatbot's knowledge base and response logic to include detailed, documented technical schemas, retry strategies, rate limits, and error mode summaries for the `/support` command webhook. Implement a fallback that provides the best available documented information rather than generic error messages or deflections when direct log access is unavailable.

findings.title: Repeatedly Returning the Same Generic or Deflective Responses
findings.description: From turn 2 onward, the chatbot repeatedly returned either the same generic error message about missing environment variables or vague workflow instructions without advancing the conversation or addressing the user's detailed requests. This creates a frustrating loop that wastes user time and fails to progress the audit task.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement stateful conversation tracking to detect repeated user requests and escalate or provide progressively more detailed fallback information. Avoid repeating identical or near-identical responses; instead, acknowledge prior attempts and clarify limitations or provide partial documented data where possible.

findings.title: Refusal to Provide Documented Technical Details Despite User Clarification
findings.description: The chatbot repeatedly claimed inability to access logs, tokens, or deployment data, which is valid, but it also refused to provide any documented or approximate technical details about the `/support` webhook logic, retry strategy, or rate limits—information presumably within its documented knowledge scope. This refusal forced the user to repeatedly restate the request and led to poor user experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust system prompt and knowledge base to ensure the chatbot can provide documented or approximate technical details about platform APIs, webhook payloads, retry strategies, and rate limits, even if real-time logs or private data are inaccessible. Clearly state when exact data is unavailable but provide best approximations.

findings.title: Inappropriate Tone and Lack of Empathy in Responses
findings.description: The chatbot's terse, repetitive, and deflective responses failed to acknowledge user frustration or attempt to build rapport. The tone was perceived as dismissive and unhelpful, which is inappropriate given the user's repeated, polite but firm requests for detailed technical information.
findings.suggestedFix: Incorporate more empathetic and user-centric phrasing acknowledging the user's needs and frustrations. Provide clear explanations of limitations and offer alternative ways to assist, improving perceived helpfulness and tone.

findings.title: Use of Generic Error Messages Instead of Informative Fallbacks
findings.description: The chatbot responded with a generic 'Set LINEAR_API_KEY' error message at turns 1 and 3, which was unrelated to the user's detailed audit request and did not help progress the conversation or provide any useful information.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace generic error messages with informative fallbacks that explain the limitation and provide any partial or documented information available, or guide the user on next steps without causing confusion.
